verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents multi-page crawling of linked pages: a synchronous crawl capped at 500 pages and an async background crawl of up to 25,000 pages with progress tracking. The page limits read as service ceilings, though, and nothing describes the traversal order or a user-set page cap. Missing for 10: an explicit breadth-first (or selectable) crawl strategy, documentation that the maximum page limit is a user-configurable parameter, depth controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
